rules-content:
Activity Rules
- Deposit threshold: 1,000 USDT, limit: 10,000 USDT
- Validity period: 7 days
- Depending on the first deposit of more than 1,000 USDT, 50% of the deposit amount will be issued to the user's account.

Equity
- The coupon can only be used as margin for opening a position, and cannot be used to offset commissions, position losses, or funding fees.
- The amount of the coupon can be withdrawn after the following conditions are met
  - Contract Volume Requirement = Coupon Amount × 6,000
  - Net Profit on Contracted Accounts = Voucher Amount * 2.5, Net Profit is the finalized profit/loss of the user after the end of the contract.

Rules for Opening Positions
- After receiving the voucher, the user's position will be opened at the market price by default using the deposit voucher.
- After receiving the coupon, the user's positions will be in full position mode, and switching to position-by-position is not supported.
- Limit orders and conditional orders do not support the use of deposit coupons.
- Voucher support follow orders
- To open a position with a deposit coupon, you need to have enough real money in your account to pay for the maintenance margin and handling fee of the position, otherwise you will not be able to open the position.

Recycling Mechanism
- After the expiration of the deposit coupon, if the trading volume requirements are not met, the amount of the deposit coupon will be recovered by the platform.
- If funds are transferred from the contract account within the validity period, the platform will recover the Deposit Ticket. If the user holds a position opened with a deposit ticket, the position will be closed automatically and the deposit ticket will be recovered at the same time.

Violations will be recalled immediately.
- It is strictly forbidden to perform illegal operations through multiple accounts in order to obtain Deposit Bonus Coupons.
- The use of virtual devices (simulators or other similar technologies) for trading, or the use of Deposit Vouchers, multiple accounts or multiple users to carry out knockout, reverse operation, volume and other malicious arbitrage, are considered violations.
- Upon discovery, the platform has the right to recover the reward coupons and improper gains and block the offending account.
